title: Pembroke Pines, Boynton Beach, Royal Palm Beach: Ad to Actual Patient

sections.label: 1 - YOUR ACCOUNT AND PATIENT PIPELINE
sections.note: Your parts 1 and 2, milestone 1. Each location's pipeline carries your stages: New Lead, Attempted Contact, Contacted, Appointment Scheduled, Confirmed, Showed, No Show, Rescheduled, Treatment Presented, Became Patient, Treatment Started.

sections.label: 2 - EVERY CALL, CLICK AND FORM KEEPS ITS SOURCE
sections.note: Your parts 3, 4 and 5, milestone 2, plus milestone 4's offline conversions; Google takes each stage up to 90 days after the click, so later ortho starts count on your dashboard only. Google gets the click ID, stage and time, never a treatment detail, and hashed contact data for enhanced conversions only if your compliance advisor signs off.

sections.label: 3 - FOLLOW-UP THAT STOPS WHEN STATUS CHANGES
sections.note: Your parts 6 and 7, milestone 3. Your 12 follow-up situations, missed calls through treatment follow-up and review requests, are 12 workflows for all 3 locations, not 36 copies, and each checks the stage before it sends.

sections.label: 4 - YOUR PRACTICE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
sections.note: Your part 8, milestone 4. A sync (your PMS's own, or an n8n or Make bridge) or the front desk moves the stage, each move reaches Google Ads, and clinical notes stay in the PMS.

sections.label: 5 - DASHBOARD BY LOCATION, READY FOR AI CALLING
sections.note: Your parts 9 and 10, milestone 5. Pembroke Pines, Boynton Beach and Royal Palm Beach side by side from leads and calls to became patient, with revenue by campaign where your PMS gives a case value.
